# Friendiary

> Friendiary is a cute personal social calendar. Everyone gets a shareable calendar page, friends propose meetups on free days, and accepted meetups appear on both calendars. Photos from past meetups live in a shared memory album.

## Main pages

- [Sign in](https://www.friendiary.com/login): log in with email or Google
- [Create an account](https://www.friendiary.com/register): sign up for free
- [Pricing](https://www.friendiary.com/pricing): free and premium plans

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.friendiary.com/privacy)
